title: La Fee aux Choux, an early narrative fiction film
summary: Alice Guy made La Fee aux Choux in 1896 and is credited as the first filmmaker to make a narrative fiction film and the first woman to direct one.
why: Helped turn moving pictures into storytelling.

notes.problem: Source records a dispute over which La Fee aux Choux is the 1896 film (it 'seems to be lost'; versions of 1900/1902 survive); 'first narrative fiction film' is a contested priority.

unsung.contribution: Directed one of the first narrative fiction films and hundreds more, experimenting with synchronised sound and colour.
unsung.recognition: She listed her films from memory hoping to win credit; the New York Times added her to 'Overlooked No More' in 2019.
